title: Edill's Coffee House
desc: East-African-inspired coffee, tea, and brunch-style café founded by Edill Hassan. Menu highlights include Biscoff crème-brûlée latte, tres-leches iced coffee, pistachio and almond croissants, cookies, and pastries. Identified by AfroToronto as a Black Muslim woman-owned café.
location: 1412 Kennedy Road, Unit 1A, Toronto, ON M1P 2L7
date: Mon–Thu 6:00 AM–9:00 PM · Fri–Sat 6:00 AM–12:00 AM · Sun 9:00 AM–10:00 PM
